epoch_length_seconds.meaning: length of one reward epoch, 1,209,600 seconds (14 days)

attacker_prior_position.meaning: attacker veTRUST position during epochs 0 to N-1 (zero)

snapshot_balance_used.meaning: veTRUST balance at the single final timestamp of epoch N used to compute reward share

snapshot_is_epoch_end.meaning: reward share for epoch N is computed from the veTRUST balance at the single final timestamp of the epoch

utilization_ratio_duration_blind.meaning: personal utilization ratio is computed only from MultiVault activity deltas between consecutive epochs and does not represent lock duration within an epoch

attacker_full_weight_claim.meaning: attacker's final-second lock registers at approximately full (~99.999%) reward weight in the epoch N snapshot
attacker_full_weight_claim.checkpoint: epoch N end to N+1 claim

attacker_contribution_seconds.meaning: duration the attacker's lock actually contributed during epoch N (one second)

assumptions: Reward share is calculated from the veTRUST balance at the single final timestamp of an epoch (pre_snapshot_mechanic).
Personal utilization ratio is computed exclusively from MultiVault activity deltas between consecutive epochs and does not represent lock duration within an epoch (pre_duration_blind_ratio).
The attack is repeatable every epoch and scales linearly with stake size, per assumption_repeatable_costless.
Exact unlockTime chosen in the final second is unspecified, so the numerical weight is approximated by the report.

unresolved.description: Report does not define a duration-weighted expected reward-share formula; only qualitative intent that duration should count, so a numeric proportional relation cannot be derived without inventing the weighting.

limitations: Direct impact impact_honest_dilution (proportional reward dilution of honest participants) is deferred to future claims; this plan formalizes only impact_full_weight_for_second.
No concrete reward amount or numeric dilution value for honest participants is supplied.
Report describes a potential attack flow; exact final-second lock timing is asserted but not demonstrated on-chain.
Authorization model of lock/reward functions is not described, so permissionless access is not independently established.
